criteria.description: One-command installer entrypoint for macOS, Debian Linux, and Windows PowerShell with consistent outcome semantics (contract AC-001/AC-004).
criteria.evidence: WP02 implemented dist/scripts/install-regnology-stack.{sh,ps1} with a shared ordered phase pipeline (preflight -> integrity -> deps -> spec-kitty -> layers -> completion) and equivalent user-facing messages across both scripts; verified against AC-004 parity criteria during WP02 review.
criteria.notes: Parity confirmed shell vs PowerShell; FR-004 Python floor defect (3.9->3.12) caught and fixed in a dedicated WP02 reopen/fix/re-review cycle.

criteria.description: Preflight validates base regnology-all-company archive accessibility before any download, distinguishing 404 / 401-403 / network outcomes (contract AC-001).
criteria.evidence: WP02 bounded-timeout HTTP HEAD probe (curl -sI --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 15 / Invoke-WebRequest -Method Head -TimeoutSec 15) on the base endpoint with distinct cause+remediation per outcome and non-zero exit before any download/extraction.
criteria.notes: Base probed before overlay; no extraction/pipx on preflight failure.

criteria.description: Preflight validates overlay ps-agent-enabled-factory archive accessibility before any download, with the same outcome distinctions as FR-002 (contract AC-001).
criteria.evidence: WP02 applies the identical bounded-timeout probe logic to the overlay endpoint, after the base probe, with matching 404/401-403/timeout discrimination.
criteria.notes: Ordering base->overlay enforced; both probed before download.

criteria.description: Installer verifies Python >= 3.12 and remediates via brew/apt/winget or exits with explicit guidance (contract AC-002).
criteria.evidence: WP02 (post-fix) enforces sys.version_info >= (3, 12) in install-regnology-stack.sh (~line 525/533) and -ge 12 in install-regnology-stack.ps1 (~line 429/437) with 'Python 3.12+ is required' messaging and platform-appropriate remediation.
criteria.notes: Defect found during WP04 review (scripts enforced 3.9+ vs required 3.12+); WP02 reopened, fixed, and re-approved.

criteria.description: Installer verifies pipx presence and installs/configures it when missing, ensuring it is on PATH for the next step (contract AC-002).
criteria.evidence: WP02 validates pipx readiness, installs via system package manager (apt/brew/winget) with pip --user fallback, then confirms pipx on PATH before the spec-kitty step.
criteria.notes: PATH confirmation gate present before dependent step.

criteria.description: spec-kitty installed via pipx at the tag-injected version; un-injected in-repo runs use default_spec_kitty_version; never an unbounded latest in the published form (contract AC-003).
criteria.evidence: WP01 pins default_spec_kitty_version: 3.2.1 and v2.0.0 spec_kitty_version: 3.2.1 in config/release-map.yaml and documents the @SPEC_KITTY_VERSION@ token contract; WP02 consumes the injected token, detecting the un-injected state (case @*@ / -like '@*@') and falling back to 3.2.1 with a logged 'fallback/unpinned mode'.
criteria.notes: Injected vs fallback paths both verified.

criteria.description: Payloads retrieved from Artifactory as the sole automatic runtime source; Bitbucket script is discovery/manual-download only, no automatic payload failover (contract AC-007).
criteria.evidence: WP02 constructs all pack/checksum download URLs from the Artifactory base env vars only; no Bitbucket payload fetch path exists. Documented in WP04 docs as discovery-only.
criteria.notes: No failover path to Bitbucket for payloads.

criteria.description: Jenkins publishing is tag-triggered, resolves pinned versions from config/release-map.yaml, injects them into published scripts, publishes only to JFrog (contract AC-005).
criteria.evidence: WP03 migrated Jenkinsfile stage gating to anyOf { buildingTag(); RUN_ON_THIS_BRANCH }, reads release-map.yaml via readYaml (awk fallback) to set SPEC_KITTY/OVERLAY/BASE/PACK versions, adds an Inject Installer Versions stage substituting @...@ tokens, and publishes only to JFrog (no Bitbucket release-publish stage).
criteria.notes: Hard error on unmapped tag and UNRESOLVED-UPSTREAM base unless ALLOW_UNRESOLVED_BASE.

criteria.description: Per-phase user-facing progress logging; on failure a single block names failing phase, target, cause, and remediation (contract AC-004 / NFR-003).
criteria.evidence: WP02 emits ordered phase banners and a consolidated failure block (phase, target, distinct cause: missing/denied/network/integrity, remediation) in both scripts.
criteria.notes: Single-block failure output verified per NFR-003.

criteria.description: Installer records component versions in a local .stack-version manifest with identical field structure across platforms (contract AC-004 / NFR-005).
criteria.evidence: WP02 writes .stack-version with installed_at, spec_kitty_version, spec_kitty_requested_version, base_pack_version, overlay_pack_version, platform in both scripts with identical structure.

criteria.description: Docs (docs/HOW_TO_INSTALL.md, dist/scripts/README.md) updated for cross-platform usage, Python 3.12, token handling, two-layer source model, fallback semantics, integrity verification, and release-tag pinning (contract AC-008).
criteria.evidence: WP04 rewrote both docs: Python 3.12 prerequisite, two-layer base/overlay source model, detached .sha256 integrity, Artifactory-only payloads with Bitbucket discovery-only fallback, release-tag pinning vs clone fallback, per-platform one-command invocations matching published entrypoints; stale 3.9/regnology-default/single-pack framing removed.
criteria.notes: Documented invocation matches published installer entrypoint names.

criteria.description: Each downloaded payload verified against its detached .sha256 after download and before extraction/pipx; mismatch deletes artifact and aborts non-zero (contract AC-006).
criteria.evidence: WP02 downloads artifact.sha256 alongside each payload and verifies via sha256sum/shasum -a 256 / Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 before extraction; on mismatch deletes the partial download, reports expected vs actual, and exits non-zero.

criteria.description: Jenkins publishes overlay archive as ps-agent-enabled-factory-<version> (not regnology-default-*) with a detached .sha256 for every published payload (contract AC-005 / AC-006).
criteria.evidence: WP03 set ARCHIVE_BASENAME to ps-agent-enabled-factory and publishes detached .sha256 for tar, zip, and both injected installer scripts; Smoke Check verifies .sha256 siblings.

criteria.description: Re-running the installer on an already-satisfied machine is idempotent: satisfied components are not reinstalled and the run exits zero with an accurate manifest (contract AC-009).
criteria.evidence: WP02 short-circuits when spec-kitty and both packs are already present at expected versions, refreshing the .stack-version manifest and exiting zero without reinstalling.
